menuconfig SETTINGS
	bool "Settings"
	help
	  Persistent key-value configuration store.

if SETTINGS

module = SETTINGS
module-str = settings
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

config SETTINGS_RUNTIME
	bool "Support setting values in runtime"
	help
	  Selects if handling setting value without use of persistent storage
	  will be activated.

config SETTINGS_DYNAMIC_HANDLERS
	bool "Support dynamic handlers"
	default y
	help
	  Support registering settings handlers dynamically
	  Use of dynamic handlers can use additional RAM while
	  static handlers use arrays generated by the linker.

choice
	prompt "Storage back-end"
	default SETTINGS_NVS if $(dt_chosen_enabled,$(DT_CHOSEN_Z_FLASH)) && !MPU_ALLOW_FLASH_WRITE && NVS
	default SETTINGS_ZMS if $(dt_chosen_enabled,$(DT_CHOSEN_Z_FLASH)) && !MPU_ALLOW_FLASH_WRITE && ZMS
	default SETTINGS_FCB if $(dt_chosen_enabled,$(DT_CHOSEN_Z_FLASH)) && !MPU_ALLOW_FLASH_WRITE && FCB
	default SETTINGS_FILE if FILE_SYSTEM
	default SETTINGS_NONE
	help
	  Storage area used by settings.
	  Either flash, using FCB or NVS, or a file if a filesystem is present.

config SETTINGS_FCB
	bool "Flash Circular Buffer (FCB)"
	depends on FCB
	select FLASH_MAP
	help
	  Use Flash Circular Buffer as storage back-end.

config SETTINGS_NVS
	bool "Non-Volatile Storage (NVS)"
	depends on NVS
	select FLASH_MAP
	help
	  Use Non-Volatile Storage (NVS) as storage back-end.

config SETTINGS_ZMS
	bool "Zephyr Memory Storage (ZMS)"
	depends on ZMS
	select FLASH_MAP
	help
	  Use Zephyr Memory Storage (ZMS) as storage back-end.

config SETTINGS_FILE
	bool "Filesystem"
	depends on FILE_SYSTEM
	help
	  Use a file on a filesystem as storage back-end.

config SETTINGS_CUSTOM
	bool "Custom storage back-end"
	help
	  Use custom storage back-end.

config SETTINGS_NONE
	bool "No storage back-end"
	help
	  No non-volatile storage back-end will be used.

endchoice

if SETTINGS_FCB

config SETTINGS_FCB_NUM_AREAS
	int "Number of flash areas available for FCB"
	default 8
	range 2 16
	help
	  How many flash areas can be used at most for FCB.

config SETTINGS_FCB_MAGIC
	hex "Magic number which identifies settings FCB header"
	default 0xc0ffeeee
	help
	  Every FCB block starts with magic number. This option provides value
	  which allows recognize that FCB applies to Settings Subsystem.

config SETTINGS_FCB_SRC
	bool "Use FCB as settings source"
	default y

config SETTINGS_FCB_DST
	bool "Use FCB as settings destination"
	default y

endif # SETTINGS_FCB

if SETTINGS_NVS

config SETTINGS_NVS_SECTOR_SIZE_MULT
	int "The NVS sector size multiplier"
	default 1
	range 1 8
	help
	  The NVS sector size is a multiple of the flash page size. This
	  option specifies the multiplier.

config SETTINGS_NVS_SECTOR_COUNT
	int "The number of sectors allocated for NVS"
	default 8
	range 2 65536
	help
	  The NVS storage size is a multiple of the NVS sector size. This
	  option specifies the number of sectors allocated for NVS.

config SETTINGS_NVS_NAME_CACHE
	bool "Cache the names of settings in RAM"
	help
	  Caching the names of the settings in RAM can deeply improve the
	  settings_load() latency on boards with slow flash read access.

config SETTINGS_NVS_NAME_CACHE_SIZE
	int "Number of entries in the name cache"
	depends on SETTINGS_NVS_NAME_CACHE
	default 128
	range 1 65536
	help
	  Number of entries in the name cache. The memory used by the cache
	  will be 4 * SETTINGS_NVS_NAME_CACHE_SIZE bytes.

endif # SETTINGS_NVS

if SETTINGS_ZMS

config SETTINGS_ZMS_SECTOR_SIZE_MULT
	int "The ZMS sector size multiplier"
	default 1
	range 1 8
	help
	  The ZMS sector size is a multiple of the flash page size. This
	  option specifies the multiplier.

config SETTINGS_ZMS_SECTOR_COUNT
	int "The number of sectors allocated for ZMS"
	default 8
	range 2 65536
	help
	  The ZMS storage size is a multiple of the ZMS sector size. This
	  option specifies the number of sectors allocated for ZMS.

endif # SETTINGS_ZMS

if SETTINGS_FILE

config SETTINGS_FILE_PATH
	string "Settings file path"
	default "/settings/run"
	help
	  Location for the file which keeps the configuration.

config SETTINGS_FILE_MAX_LINES
	int "Maximum number of compressed records in settings file"
	default 32
	help
	  If the number of lines in the settings file exceeds this value,
	  the file will be compressed (duplicate entries removed).

endif # SETTINGS_FILE

config SETTINGS_ENCODE_LEN
	bool "Encode length of value in the storage"
	depends on SETTINGS_FCB
	help
	  Encode length of value in the storage.

config SETTINGS_SHELL
	bool "Settings shell"
	depends on SHELL
	depends on SETTINGS_RUNTIME
	help
	  Enable the settings shell.

endif # SETTINGS
